name: Accessibility Engineer Pack
description: Workflows for coding agents shipping accessible UIs: WCAG 2.2 AA auditing and remediation, accessible component implementation, browser-based verification, and clear documentation of accessibility decisions.
useCases: Audit a UI against WCAG 2.2 AA and produce a prioritized remediation plan.
Implement accessible components with correct semantics, keyboard support, and focus management.
Verify accessibility fixes in the browser and document the decisions for reviewers.
examplePrompts: Audit this page against WCAG 2.2 AA and list violations with severity, affected users, and concrete fixes.
Make this modal dialog fully keyboard- and screen-reader-accessible, then verify it in the browser.
